CREATE TABLE `runtime_external_payload_deletions` (
  `id` varchar(26) NOT NULL,
  `namespace` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `storage_uri` text NOT NULL,
  `storage_uri_sha256` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `storage_policy` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`storage_policy`)),
  `attempts` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `failure_code` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `runtime_payload_deletions_namespace_uri_unique` (`namespace`,`storage_uri_sha256`),
  KEY `runtime_payload_deletions_namespace_created_index` (`namespace`,`created_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
